title: "Plan & approve first" did not wait for me
happened: I ticked it, the agent went straight to a PR.
fix: Block Build until the plan has a human approval when that step is on.

title: "Worker still finishing" on a finished Worker
happened: The desktop app warned me 28 minutes after the run ended. The web board had it right.
fix: Read the Worker state from the same source the web board uses.

title: Browser tickets default to Cloud
happened: A ticket made in the browser ran on Cloud, and the browser cannot switch it to my machine.
fix: Default new tickets to the last machine I used, and list my paired desktop in the browser.

title: My ticket titles get rewritten
happened: I typed a title, the card showed a different one.
fix: Keep my title, offer the rewrite as a suggestion.

title: Docs and app disagree
happened: The docs describe Plan and Build with Cmd+Y, the app shows workflows.
fix: Update the ticket docs to the workflow picker.
